text: I am not a supporting seat. Whichever trigger the camp ratifies, my objection is the same: it fires on any volume. A Creek pull-in is not a CAN SLIM entry; a bar_high break is closer, but only on volume at least 1.4x normal (C16). day_vol 0.81 fails R4, coil -- leaves no countable base (R3), and W 6.13% and D 3.16% under the 20-bar high is not a new high out of a base (C7). I hold OPPOSE. What clears it: a new high on day_vol 1.40 or more.
